translations.web: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.
translations.bsb: Slash to the right; set your blade to the left— wherever your blade is directed.
translations.kjv: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
translations.asv: Gather thee together, go to the right, set thyself in array, go to the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
